source_intent: Recover optional exact-name discovery, operator-reviewed mapping and native effect presentation from the remaining Claude work without replacing hardened gameplay authority.
implementation: Original adapter and tests; only project-owned presentation classes changed. Optional native types are looked up through fixed public ownership contracts.
runtime_configuration: No inferred active defaults; strict verified:true accepted schema and atomic snapshot publication. Name inference remains in a separate unverified proposal tool.
source_hooks: Separate cosmetic HandTechnique state and WeaponPulse receipt lease
economic_authority: No native cast, resource reservation/consumption, cooldown, XP or boss contribution mutation.
reference_access: Registry metadata and public method/field signatures only; no reference method bodies, decompilation, textures, models or distributions included.
distribution: Source, tests, synthetic fixture and safe records only; private compile JARs and runtime inputs stay outside Git.
